summary: Audited all 2000 MCQs in waves 5-8 (Units 3 and 4) against the locked 0264 whitelist/blacklist. 1954 items passed and 46 were rejected for syllabus non-compliance. Rejects were driven mainly by buffer inventory/buffer stock (29), convenience sampling (5), cash cow (3), PED formula calculations (4), payback period (2), Hawthorne effect (1), zero-hours contract (1) and Statistical Process Control/control charts (1). Cross-checking the flagged manifest confirmed its 32 syllabus-relevant IDs and added 14 newly discovered ones (069, 196, 514, 955 and ten buffer-inventory items); manifest duplicates and explanation-quality flags were excluded as out of scope for a syllabus audit.
